headline: Declan Rice strikes late for Arsenal to deny Bayern Munich in blockbuster
standfirst: Champions League: Bayern 2 (Davies 35, Kane 61 pen) Arsenal 2 (Eze 25, Rice 82) It is as if Harry Kane cannot get enough of tormenting Arsenal.
body_markdown:
Champions League: Bayern 2 (Davies 35, Kane 61 pen) Arsenal 2 (Eze 25, Rice 82) It is as if Harry Kane cannot get enough of tormenting Arsenal. The Bayern Munich striker has plenty of form from his Tottenham days. He remains the top scorer in north London derby history with 14 goals. (The Irish Times)

**Vanguard** adds: Arsenal coach Mikel Arteta said the club was “concerned” about the severity of an injury to winger Bukayo Saka after Wednesday’s pulsating 2-2 Champions League draw at Bayern Munich. Saka, Arsenal’s joint top goalscorer this season alongside Victor Gyokeres, went off early after falling to the turf grabbing his thigh and was replaced by Eberechi Eze.

**The Guardian Sport** adds: It is as if Harry Kane cannot get enough of tormenting Arsenal. The Bayern Munich striker has plenty of form from his Tottenham days.

**BBC Sport** adds: Declan Rice scores a late equaliser as Arsenal and Bayern Munich play out an entertaining draw in the league phase of the Champions League while Bukayo Saka limps off with an early injury.

**Sky Sports** adds: Declan Rice scored a superb 82nd-minute equaliser as Arsenal fought back to draw 2-2 with Bayern Munich in a thrilling Champions League encounter at the Allianz Arena.

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by Channel NewsAsia, The Guardian Sport, BBC Sport, Vanguard, Sky Sports, Al Jazeera and The Irish Times. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
